mods.name: CENTRAL GAMING STATION
mods.description: Mod about Questionable Items,Canibalism and food.

releases.notes:
Project Changes
===============

Cursed Bibles
-------------
- Added item models for Cursed Bibles I, II, III, and IV.
- Added matching texture assets for Cursed Bibles I, II, III, and IV.
- Cursed Bibles use the custom CGT TAB.
- Added a shapeless recipe using three paper and one Human Leather to craft
  Cursed Bible I.
- Added a Torn Page recipe using Paper, Human Flesh, and Human Leather.
- Added shapeless progression recipes that combine each of Cursed Bibles I, II,
  and III with a Torn Page to craft the next volume.

Sheep Milking
-------------
- Removed Sheep Milk from sheep death drops.
- Adult sheep can be milked by right-clicking with:
  - A glass bottle to receive Sheep Milk.
  - A bowl to receive Sheep Milk Bowl.
  - A bucket to receive Sheep Milk Bucket.
  - A basket to receive Sheep Milk Basket.

Drops
------------
- Replaced the player, zombie, pillager, and villager torso, arm, and leg drops
  with one matching corpse item.
- Added Farmers Delight chopping recipes that turn each corpse into its
  matching torso, two arms, two legs, and head.

Effigy
------
- Extended the Effigy's selectable hitbox to two blocks tall.
- Added a GUI texture at assets/cgt_mod/textures/gui/effigy.png.
- Updated the Effigy screen to render the texture with the textured GUI shader
  and correct texture dimensions.

Jar
---

- Added a one-slot GUI that accepts stackable items.
- Stored items persist in the Jar and drop when the Jar is broken.
- Made the Jar glass transparent and render its stored item inside.
- Jar contents now rotate to face the viewer.
- Lowered the rendered Jar contents by 0.2, then raised them by 0.1.



Creative Tab
------------
- Changed the CGT TAB icon to cycle through the Pillager, Player, Skeleton,
  Villager, and Zombie heads on sticks.


  Item Changes
  ----------------
  
- Renamed Zombie Head Jar to Jar and made it a placeable block.
- Added Pillager,Villager,Zombie,Corpse
- Added Player, Pillager, Villager, Zombie, and Skeleton Head Pots.
- Removed Wedding Ring.
- Removed Diamond Fragment.
- Removed all Effigy versions except the Empty Effigy.

Wandering Trader
----------------
- Each wandering trader has a 5% chance to receive an extra trade offer for
  one randomly selected highshroom variant.
- The offer gives one highshroom for a random cost of 1 to 5 emeralds.
- The chance is rolled once per trader and saved to prevent rerolls or
  duplicate offers when the trader is reloaded.
